Class GameScene

java.lang.Object
dev.marasmium.kit.applib.Scene
dev.marasmium.kit.apptest.scenes.GameScene
All Implemented Interfaces:
InputListener, NetListener, UIListener
public class GameScene extends Scene implements UIListener
The main game scene of the application framework's app test program
